name: rentemester-document-party-links-v26
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS document_party_link_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES documents(id),
 party_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(party_id) BETWEEN 3 AND 64),
 party_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(party_role IN ('customer','vendor','owner','adviser','employee','authority','bank')),
 event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('linked','superseded')),
 evidence_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_kind IN ('exact_identifier','reviewed_legacy_reference')),
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(evidence_json)),
 document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_sha256)=64),
 document_payload_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(document_payload_sha256)=64),
 party_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(json_valid(party_snapshot_json)),
 plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
 idempotency_key TEXT,
 reason TEXT,
 actor TEXT NOT NULL,
 principal TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(document_id, party_role, event_type, plan_hash),
 UNIQUE(idempotency_key)
);
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS current_document_party_links AS
 SELECT e.* FROM document_party_link_events e
 WHERE e.event_type='linked' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_party_link_events s WHERE s.event_type='superseded' AND s.document_id=e.document_id AND s.party_role=e.party_role AND s.plan_hash=e.plan_hash);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS document_party_link_events_document ON document_party_link_events(document_id,party_role,id);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_party_link_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON document_party_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document party link events are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS document_party_link_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON document_party_link_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'document party link events are append-only'); END;
